label: Samsung QN65LS03D
description: 65-inch Samsung The Frame (LS03D, 2024) art-mode QLED smart TV on Tizen. All of its ports live on the One Connect box that reaches the panel over a single thin cable: one Ethernet LAN RJ45 of Fast Ethernet (10/100) class, Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) dual-band and Bluetooth 5.2 for the SolarCell remote, plus four HDMI inputs (HDMI 4 at 4K120), two USB-A ports, optical audio out, an RF input and an Ex-Link RS-232C jack. It is mains powered with no PoE.
notes: Samsung's spec detail: 'Ethernet (LAN) 1', 'Wi-Fi Yes (Wi-Fi 5)', 'Bluetooth Yes (BT5.2)', 'HDMI 4', 'USB 2 x USB-A', 'Ex-Link (RS-232C) 1', 'One Connect (Y22 4K)' - the 2024 Frame routes every port through the One Connect box, so the visible ports are on the box, not the panel. Samsung does not publish the LAN rate; current sets are 10/100, hence 100M. Tizen exposes a remote-control/REST API over HTTP (port 8001 for the websocket pairing flow), so http-server is declared. No PoE.
